why_v1_is_not_reusable.primary_comparison: v1 registered wilcoxon(zero_method='wilcox') on max_f1_star vs greedy anchor. The anchor is seeded into the NSGA-II population (sss_core/nsga2.py:172-183), so max_f1_star >= anchor holds BY CONSTRUCTION; measured, 49 of 50 recorded units have max_f1_star EXACTLY equal to the anchor. zero_method='wilcox' discards those zeros, leaving <= 1 valid pair per variant against an n_guard of 5, so all five variants could only report 'insufficient'. The test never had power and was never run.

primary_comparison.estimand: dq_all = max{ f_q(p) : p in front } - f_q(anchor point in that front)
primary_comparison.why_this_estimand: the anchor is the COVERAGE-maximal point, so any estimand conditioned on f1 >= anchor_f1 can only ever admit the anchor itself. Measured on the 49 v1 units with a locatable anchor: dq (quality at matched coverage) = 0/49 nonzero, dom (strict domination) = 0/49, mq (coverage at matched quality) = 0/49 -- all structurally tied. dq_all is the only candidate that relaxes coverage, which is the only direction the front actually moves: 20/49 nonzero, sd 0.940
primary_comparison.stratum_rule: a priori anchor-degeneracy, frozen BEFORE v2: a family is in the structural-null stratum if it is the all-STR degenerate-anchor family or its median distinct_fq < 2
primary_comparison.stratum_rule_outcome_on_v1_evidence: Applying the rule as written to the v1 synthetic families: M1NC and M3NC are the all-STR degenerate-anchor families (STRUCT-NULL by the first clause); M2WF has median distinct_fq 1.5 < 2 (STRUCT-NULL by the second clause); M2WH and M4WH have median 2.0 (PRIMARY). The primary stratum is therefore M2WH + M4WH, pooled n = 20 on v1 data. NOTE this differs from the ticket-22 working note, which had provisionally listed M2WF as primary on the grounds of its dq_all spread; the RULE is authoritative over that note, and the rule was frozen before v2 rather than tuned to keep a family in.
primary_comparison.primary_test: scipy.stats.ttest_1samp(dq_all_pooled, popmean=0.0, alternative='greater')  # one-sided, pooled over the primary stratum
primary_comparison.zeros: RETAINED. A zero dq_all is a true 'no quality headroom', not a missing value; no zero_method filtering anywhere in this test
primary_comparison.secondary: the same one-sided test per family, Holm-adjusted across the primary stratum, for locating only
primary_comparison.robustness_gate: a sign-flip permutation p (1e5 flips, numpy only) is reported alongside; if the t and permutation p disagree across alpha, the result is reported INCONCLUSIVE
primary_comparison.multiplicity: the primary test is a single pooled test and carries no correction; the per-family Holm is secondary
primary_comparison.known_power: Power is stated for the OPERATIVE stratum, which the stratum rule determines (see stratum_rule_outcome_on_v1_evidence: M2WH + M4WH, pooled n = 20, measured mean 0.81072, sd 0.88042 on v1 dq_all). At n=20 the MDE at 80% power, one-sided alpha 0.05, is 0.579*sd = 0.5099. At n=10 per family it is 0.86*sd. IMPORTANT: v1 measured that sd on the coverage-era artifacts and the estimand is defined for v2, so this does NOT certify the design -- v2 records the pooled test as primary and reports the achieved effect regardless of significance. The superseded ticket-22 note had provisionally pooled three families at n=30, sd 1.05854; those figures belong to that note, not to this freeze.

coverage_parity_as_result.statement: The greedy anchor is retained as an elite in the initial population under an elitist algorithm, so every front's coverage-maximal member equals the anchor's coverage: 49/50 exact ties in v1, the 50th +0.1. This is a STRUCTURAL consequence of the warm start, not an empirical finding. v2 makes no coverage-improvement claim and runs no significance test on the coverage axis
coverage_parity_as_result.paper_wording: Reported as a construction and a count, in the results, as a result. It is neither a failure of the search nor an omission.

convergence_criterion.subject: distinct_fq per unit per budget (NOT front_size)
convergence_criterion.plateau_rule: CONVERGED iff |median_i s_{i,b1} - median_i s_{i,b0}| <= 1.0 AND max_i |s_{i,b1} - s_{i,b0}| <= 2.0 (v1's rule, inherited unchanged)
convergence_criterion.median_definition: difference of medians across the top budget pair, NOT the median of per-seed deltas (v1 audit found these conflated; the two differ by ~50x)
convergence_criterion.unconverged_action: if any stratum is UNCONVERGED, v2 reports NOT-YET-CONVERGED for that stratum and makes NO physical claim about it. 'Front collapse' and 'phase transition' are forbidden declarations in every branch

promotion_convergence.why: v1's robustness_note asserted 'dead at all budgets, already established and expected to hold' -- a conclusion whose warrant was an empirical expectation rather than a proof, while the readout itself was never converged
promotion_convergence.ladder: the same budget ladder as the main matrix; escalation beyond 160/240 is a new decision because the allowance is consumed
promotion_convergence.plateau_criterion: CONVERGED(f) iff |median_i s_{i,b1} - median_i s_{i,b0}| <= 1.0 dB AND max_i |s_{i,b1} - s_{i,b0}| <= 2.0 dB, applied to promotion.spread_db over the top budget pair, per family

structural_dimension.quantity: R_fam = max over (task x feasible start x routed mode x registered PRF) of unenforced aasr_direct_db, minus the min; budget- and solver-independent
structural_dimension.domain_correction: the 6.0 dB threshold lives in the unenforced-AASR domain. The earlier formulation compared it against f_Q, which is m^-2 and cannot be compared to a dB threshold; v2 measures the structural bound in AASR dB
structural_dimension.v1_evidence: all nine registered families measured below 6.0 dB (M1NC/M3NC 0.037, M2WH 5.379, M2WF 5.464, M4WH 5.499, P6WH 5.439, P7WH 5.456, P8WH 5.501, P9WH 5.303) while the platform-level range is 71.03 dB: the platform can express the spread, the registered families cannot
structural_dimension.knife_edge_disclosure: P8WH sits 0.499 dB below the threshold and shares the aasr_direct model with the readout, which carries the registered D06-6 limitation (M=1 uniform aperture; Song's scan-dependent element pattern is not reproduced). 'Structurally dead' is a MODEL-level statement and is labelled as such; it is never stated as physics

two_dimensional_verdict.DEAD_CONVERGED: non-triggerable by structural bound (budget-independent) and the readout converged to a plateau below threshold
two_dimensional_verdict.DEAD_UNCONVERGED: non-triggerable by structural bound ONLY; the readout is NOT-YET-CONVERGED (still ascending toward R_fam). The deadness is stated as structural, explicitly not as a converged-readout result
two_dimensional_verdict.ALIVE_CONVERGED: the scenario admits spreads up to R_fam >= 6.0 dB; the plateau value is reported with a budget caveat, and promotion fires iff the plateau >= 6.0
two_dimensional_verdict.ALIVE_UNCONVERGED: NO CLAIM. The scenario admits >= 6.0 dB and the readout has not plateaued; report NOT-YET-CONVERGED and forbid any alive/dead assertion

capacity_artifacts.status: NOT YET DERIVED in v2. The serial-bound derivation and its measured value belong to the ticket-17 items that follow this freeze; until they land, no specific capacity number may appear in the paper
capacity_artifacts.rule: the serial-bound transfer term is min-over-pairs (a legal lower bound); the observation is the closure DEVIATION PATTERN vs the overload axis, never the closure level itself (which is near-tautological at a single constant)

forbidden: changing any frozen threshold after seeing results: promotion 6.0 dB, AASR -13 dB main, plateau 1.0/2.0 dB, solver pop/gen ladder, alpha 0.05
declaring front collapse or a phase transition in any branch, converged or not (already falsified)
any physical claim about a stratum whose convergence verdict is UNCONVERGED

predictions.note: A preregistration that cannot be wrong is the failure this file exists to prevent. Each prediction states the quantity, the threshold, and the observation that would refute it. Thresholds are NOT tuned to v1 evidence; they are the ones the spec already fixed.

P1_front_richness.quantity: median distinct_fq per density band, at the top budget of the registered ladder (160/240), in the real-window family
P1_front_richness.prediction: median distinct_fq >= 3 in EVERY density band, at sufficient budget
P1_front_richness.refutation: any band whose ladder has PLATEAUED (CONVERGED per convergence_criterion) and still shows median distinct_fq < 3
P1_front_richness.critical_caveat: if a band is UNCONVERGED the prediction is NOT-YET-TESTED for that band, not refuted. Reporting a refutation for an unconverged band is a forbidden move.
P1_front_richness.forbidden_if_refuted: no statement of 'front collapse' or 'phase transition' -- the prediction is about richness at sufficient budget, and its failure means the budget was insufficient or the front is genuinely narrow, neither of which licenses a phase-transition claim

P2_quality_headroom.quantity: dq_all pooled over the primary stratum (P-estimand, one-sided test above)
P2_quality_headroom.prediction: the search confers measurable quality headroom over the greedy anchor at matched front, i.e. mean dq_all > 0 with the pooled one-sided test rejecting at alpha 0.05
P2_quality_headroom.refutation: the pooled test fails to reject -- reported as a RESULT ('no measurable quality headroom'), never as a failure of the experiment
P2_quality_headroom.mandatory_wording: the coverage-parity statement travels with this result in every branch

P3_promotion.quantity: promotion two-dimensional verdict (structural R_fam x budget convergence)
P3_promotion.prediction: promotion does not fire in the registered real-window families
P3_promotion.refutation: any unit whose spread_db >= 6.0 dB, OR any family whose R_fam >= 6.0 dB (structural liveness)
P3_promotion.note: the v1 evidence supports non-firing but on the SYNTHETIC families; the real-window families have different geometry and the prediction is re-tested, not inherited

P4_capacity.quantity: closure of served against the serial bound, per overload band
P4_capacity.prediction: WITHHELD until the serial-bound derivation lands (see capacity_artifacts). No capacity number may be predicted before its derivation is registered.
P4_capacity.reason: predicting a number whose derivation does not yet exist would be a retrofit, which is the thing this file is meant to prevent

stratum_rule_determinacy.problem: the reviewer found the stratum rule under-specified: 'all-STR degenerate-anchor family OR median distinct_fq < 2' has no defined analogue of M1NC's all-STR property for the R families, and a per-seed median can flip between strata on a reseed
stratum_rule_determinacy.fix: the rule is evaluated ONCE, on the registered base seed and the base budget, per family -- not per seed and not averaged over the ladder. A family's stratum is a property of that family's registered base run
stratum_rule_determinacy.all_STR_clause_for_R_families: the R families are defined by demand tier, not by mode, so the all-STR clause is replaced by its measurable content: a family is structural-null if distinct_fq at the registered base run is IDENTICALLY 1 for every unit (zero spread), which is the condition that makes dq_all's sd exactly zero
stratum_rule_determinacy.median_clause: median distinct_fq < 2 is evaluated at the registered base seed and base budget only
